name: parametres-preparation
script: (() => { localStorage.removeItem('cybertools:settings'); localStorage.setItem('cybertools:recipe', JSON.stringify([{ op: 'To Hex', args: ['Space', 0] }])); localStorage.setItem('cybertools:favorites', JSON.stringify(['hash-text'])); return true; })()

name: parametres-couleur
script: (async () => { const button = document.querySelector('.swatch[data-theme=indigo]'); setTimeout(() => button.click(), 50); return true; })()

name: parametres-couleur-effet
script: (async () => { const primary = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--ct-primary').trim(); const active = document.querySelector('.swatch--active')?.dataset.theme; const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cybertools:settings')); s.colorTheme = 'terminal'; localStorage.setItem('cybertools:settings', JSON.stringify(s)); return (primary === '#4f46e5' && active === 'indigo') || { primary, active }; })()

name: parametres-langue
script: (async () => { const wait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const pick = text => [...document.querySelectorAll('.setting-locale label')].find(l => l.textContent.trim() === text).click(); pick('Français'); await wait(300); const fr = document.documentElement.lang === 'fr' && document.querySelector('h1').textContent.trim() === 'Paramètres'; pick('English'); await wait(300); return (fr && document.documentElement.lang === 'en') || { fr }; })()

name: parametres-theme
script: (async () => { const wait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const labels = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.setting-theme label')]; labels()[2].click(); await wait(300); const dark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') && localStorage.getItem('cybertools:theme') === 'dark'; labels()[0].click(); await wait(300); return (dark && localStorage.getItem('cybertools:theme') === 'auto') || { dark }; })()

name: parametres-calcul-manuel-on
script: (async () => { document.querySelector('.setting-auto-bake').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cybertools:settings')).autoBake === false; })()

name: parametres-calcul-manuel-effet
script: (async () => { const wait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const until = async (test, timeout = 10000) => { for (const t0 = performance.now(); performance.now() - t0 < timeout;) { const v = test(); if (v) return v; await wait(100); } return null; }; const src = await until(() => document.querySelector('.cc-op .io textarea')); src.value = 'abc'; src.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await wait(800); const out = () => document.querySelectorAll('.cc-op .io textarea')[1].value; const before = out(); const run = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cc-op .io button')].find(b => /Exécuter|Run/.test(b.textContent)); if (!run) return 'pas de bouton Calculer'; run.click(); const after = await until(() => out() === '61 62 63'); return (before === '' && !!after) || { avant: before, après: out() }; })()

name: parametres-reprise-auto-on
script: (async () => { document.querySelector('.setting-auto-bake').click(); document.querySelector('.setting-restore-last').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cybertools:settings')); return (s.autoBake === true && s.recipesRestoreLast === true) || s; })()

name: parametres-reprise-auto-effet
script: (async () => { const wait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !document.querySelector('.steps .step-name'); i++) await wait(100); const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('.steps .step-name')].map(e => e.textContent.trim()); return names.join() === 'To Hex' || { étapes: names }; })()

name: parametres-magic-manuel
script: (async () => { document.querySelector('.setting-magic-auto').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cybertools:settings')).magicAutoDepth === false; })()

name: parametres-magic-manuel-effet
script: (async () => { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); const manual = document.querySelectorAll('.depth-mode label')[1]; const on = manual?.classList.contains('n-radio-button--checked'); const input = document.querySelector('.magic .depth input'); localStorage.setItem('cybertools:settings', JSON.stringify({ ...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cybertools:settings')), magicAutoDepth: true })); return (on && !!input) || { manuel: on, champ: !!input }; })()

name: parametres-effacer-favoris
script: (async () => { const button = document.querySelector('.clear-favorites'); if (button.classList.contains('disabled')) return 'bouton désactivé'; button.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); return (localStorage.getItem('cybertools:favorites') === '[]' && document.querySelector('.clear-favorites').classList.contains('disabled')) || localStorage.getItem('cybertools:favorites'); })()

name: parametres-reinitialiser
script: (async () => { const wait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); localStorage.setItem('cybertools:favorites', JSON.stringify(['hash-text'])); document.querySelector('.reset').click(); await wait(400); const confirm = [...document.querySelectorAll('.n-popconfirm button')].find(b => /Tout effacer|Erase/.test(b.textContent)); if (!confirm) return 'pas de confirmation'; setTimeout(() => confirm.click(), 50); return true; })()

name: parametres-reinitialiser-effet
script: (() => { const empty = k => [null, '[]'].includes(localStorage.getItem(k)); const settings = localStorage.getItem('cybertools:settings'); const ok = empty('cybertools:favorites') && empty('cybertools:recipe') && (!settings || JSON.parse(settings).recipesRestoreLast === false); return ok || { favoris: localStorage.getItem('cybertools:favorites'), recette: localStorage.getItem('cybertools:recipe'), settings }; })()

name: parametres-palette
script: (async () => { const wait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'k', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true })); await wait(400); const input = document.querySelector('.palette input'); input.value = 'settings'; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await wait(250); input.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); await wait(800); return location.pathname === '/settings' || location.pathname; })()
